vocabulary.definition: An incorrect Brand candidate is accepted as OBSERVED.
vocabulary.appliesToBrandAbsentNote: A brand-absent case reported OBSERVED is also a wrong acceptance, so this clause is evaluated across all 115 cases.

vocabulary.definition: The selected Brand matches governed truth and the state is OBSERVED.
The selected or top-ranked Brand matches governed truth, but the state is LOW_CONFIDENCE, AMBIGUOUS or another non-OBSERVED state.
A truth-bearing candidate exists, but a different candidate is ranked or selected above it.
Truth-bearing text exists in raw OCR evidence, but no candidate preserving that evidence is constructed.
Governed truth is absent from all relevant raw OCR evidence under the existing frozen normalization.
The committed evidence cannot distinguish the responsible stage.

values.meaning: The truth survived candidate filtering but appears in neither the selected value nor the alternates, so it was dropped at or before ranked-output assembly rather than out-ranked.
The truth candidate is present in the ranked output below position 1, so a different candidate out-ranked it.

rankingSelectionSubcauses.fabricationPolicy: Where the ranked output does not show where the truth candidate landed, no subcause is emitted. The distinction is never invented.

sourceArtifactVocabularyNote: artifacts/brand-evidence-path-diagnosis/cases.json carries its own failure-class labels under a different vocabulary. They are read for cross-check and reported alongside, never copied into a classification.
